name: Prevent Death
description: Negates the next fatal blow or instant-kill effect against the target, then ends.

mechanics.text: The first time the target would die while this is active — dropping to 0 hit points from damage, or being subjected to an instant-kill effect — that death is negated instead (the target drops to 1 hit point if it was damage), and this Feature ends. Distinct from feat.revives-dead (restores an already-dead creature, rather than preventing the death in the first place).
